description: Source code for Mattermost server API handling content flagging features, including route initialization, permission checks, post flagging, reviewer management, and configuration endpoints.

classes.name: API
classes.description: Main API handler struct for content flagging endpoints.

methods.name: InitContentFlagging
methods.description: Initializes content flagging related routes if feature flag is enabled.

methods.name: requireContentFlaggingAvailable
methods.description: Checks if content flagging feature is available under license.

methods.name: requireContentFlaggingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if content flagging is enabled in configuration.

methods.name: contentFlaggingRequired
methods.description: Middleware to enforce content flagging enabled check.

methods.name: requireTeamContentReviewer
methods.description: Verifies if user is a reviewer for a team.

methods.name: requireFlaggedPost
methods.description: Validates that a post is flagged.

methods.name: getFlaggingConfiguration
methods.description: Returns content flagging configuration, with extra info for reviewers.

methods.name: getTeamPostFlaggingFeatureStatus
methods.description: Returns whether content flagging is enabled for a team.

methods.name: flagPost
methods.description: Flags a post content.

methods.name: getFlaggingConfig
methods.description: Builds configuration object for reporting, tailored for reviewers.

methods.name: getContentFlaggingFields
methods.description: Retrieves mapped content flagging fields.

methods.name: getPostPropertyValues
methods.description: Fetches content flagging property values for a post, if user is reviewer.

methods.name: getFlaggedPost
methods.description: Retrieves a flagged post if user has permission.

methods.name: removeFlaggedPost
methods.description: Permanently deletes a flagged post.

methods.name: keepFlaggedPost
methods.description: Marks a flagged post to be kept.

methods.name: keepRemoveFlaggedPostChecks
methods.description: Performs common checks for keep/remove actions on flagged posts.

methods.name: saveContentFlaggingSettings
methods.description: Saves content flagging configuration settings.

methods.name: getContentFlaggingSettings
methods.description: Retrieves current content flagging settings.

methods.name: searchReviewers
methods.description: Searches for reviewers within a team based on a search term.

methods.name: assignFlaggedPostReviewer
methods.description: Assigns a reviewer to a flagged post.

methods.name: checkPostTypeFlaggable
methods.description: Checks if a post type is eligible for flagging.
